cases.script:
printf 'pear
apple
pear
' | sort | uniq > sorted
printf 'apple
pear
' > expected
cmp sorted expected
value=$(printf abc | tr a-z A-Z)
test "$value" = ABC
printf 'shell: ok
'

mkdir data
printf 'payload\n' > data/original
cp data/original data/copy
mv data/copy data/moved
ln data/original data/hard
ln -s original data/link
cmp data/moved data/link
test "$(stat -c %s data/hard)" = 8
test "$(find data -type f | wc -l)" = 3
printf 'files: ok\n'

printf 'one:3\ntwo:5\n' > input
grep '^two:' input > selected
sed 's/two/TWO/' selected > replaced
test "$(cut -d: -f1 replaced)" = TWO
test "$(awk -F: '{s += $2} END {print s}' input)" = 8
printf 'text: ok\n'

mkdir source restored
printf 'archive payload\n' > source/value
tar -cf payload.tar source
gzip -c payload.tar > payload.gz
gzip -dc payload.gz > recovered.tar
cmp payload.tar recovered.tar
bzip2 -c payload.tar > payload.bz2
bzip2 -dc payload.bz2 > recovered.tar
cmp payload.tar recovered.tar
xz -c payload.tar > payload.xz
xz -dc payload.xz > recovered.tar
cmp payload.tar recovered.tar
tar -xf recovered.tar -C restored
cmp source/value restored/source/value
printf 'archive: ok\n'

printf abc > input
base64 input > encoded
base64 -d encoded > decoded
cmp input decoded
test "$(sha256sum decoded | cut -d' ' -f1)" = ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
printf 'hash: ok\n'

python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, hashlib, json, pathlib, sqlite3
p=pathlib.Path('data.json'); p.write_text(json.dumps({'answer':42},sort_keys=True))
assert json.loads(p.read_text())['answer']==42
payload=b'trames python payload'*1000
assert gzip.decompress(gzip.compress(payload))==payload
assert len(hashlib.sha256(payload).digest())==32
c=sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite'); c.execute('create table t (v integer)'); c.executemany('insert into t values (?)',[(1,),(2,),(3,)])
c.commit(); assert c.execute('select sum(v) from t').fetchone()[0]==6; c.close()
print('python: ok')
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import concurrent.futures, os, socket, subprocess, sys
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','import sys;sys.stdout.buffer.write(sys.stdin.buffer.read()[::-1])'],input=b'payload'*20000,capture_output=True,check=True)
assert p.stdout==(b'payload'*20000)[::-1]
a,b=socket.socketpair(); a.sendall(b'socketpair'); assert b.recv(32)==b'socketpair'; a.close(); b.close()
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as pool: assert sum(pool.map(lambda n:n*n,range(100)))==328350
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0: os._exit(17)
assert os.waitpid(pid,0)[1]==17<<8
print('python-process: ok')
PY

export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q -b main repo
git -C repo config user.email acceptance@localhost
git -C repo config user.name Acceptance
printf 'tracked payload\n' > repo/file
git -C repo add file
git -C repo commit -qm initial
git -C repo checkout -qb feature
printf 'feature\n' >> repo/file
git -C repo commit -qam feature
git -C repo checkout -q main
git -C repo merge -q --ff-only feature
git clone -q --no-local file:///work/repo clone
cmp repo/file clone/file
test "$(git -C clone rev-list --count HEAD)" = 2
printf 'git: ok\n'

printf 'curl file payload\n' > input
curl --fail --silent --show-error file:///work/input -o downloaded
cmp input downloaded
printf 'curl-file: ok\n'

ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C acceptance -f key
ssh-keygen -y -f key > derived
cut -d' ' -f1,2 key.pub > original
cut -d' ' -f1,2 derived > actual
cmp actual original
printf 'ssh-key: ok\n'

printf '#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){puts("compiled: ok");return 0;}\n' > hello.c
printf 'all:\n\tgcc hello.c -o hello\n' > Makefile
make -s
./hello > result
printf 'compiled: ok\n' > expected
cmp expected result
printf 'build: ok\n'
